name: ZipFiles
label: Zip Files
description: Compress one or more files or folders into a zip archive.

fields.name: SourcePaths
fields.label: Source Paths
fields.description: Accepts: string[], List<string>, or comma-separated string of file/folder paths.

fields.name: CompressionLevelType
fields.label: Compression Level
fields.description: The compression level to use: Optimal, Fastest, or NoCompression.

fields.name: OutputZipPath
fields.label: Output Zip Path
fields.description: Full path where the ZIP file will be saved (e.g., C:\temp\archive.zip).

fields.name: OutputZipFullPath
fields.label: Output Zip Full Path
fields.description: Returns the full path of the created ZIP file.
